description: Na₃SiCSbO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.66 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.94 Å. Si is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.64-1.69 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.32 Å. Sb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.47 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four Na and one C atom to form distorted ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₄C trigonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂SiSb tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Na, one C, and one Sb atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Si, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Si, and one Sb atom to form distorted edge-sharing ONa₂SiSb tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Si, and one Sb atom.
